channel.title: What's Up? Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from What's Up? Media (whatsupmag.com)

item.title: Chamber Announces Leadership Transition Honoring Outgoing President & CEO and Appointing Amy Berry as Successor
item.description: The Anne Arundel County Chamber of Commerce today announced a leadership transition, marking the departure of President & CEO Mark Kleinschmidt after seven years of dedicated service, and the promotion of Amy Berry to President & CEO.

item.title: Rotary Club of Annapolis Awards Grants from Crab Feast Proceeds
item.description: Each summer, the Rotary Club of Annapolis holds its Crab Feast, which is a major annual fundraiser with all proceeds donated to local charities and non-profit organizations.

item.title: Rotary Club of Annapolis Is Accepting Scholarships
item.description: The Rotary Club of Annapolis, an organization of business, civic, and professional community leaders, is offering academic scholarships to graduating seniors attending local high schools.

item.title: Partners In Care Maryland, Inc., Fostering a sense of connection and community
item.description: When Kathy Butler and her husband retired, they decided to become members of Partners In Care Maryland, Inc. (PIC), a volunteer-based nonprofit organization that empowers older adults to maintain their independence and stay active in the community.

item.title: Annapolis Expert of the Month: Lauren Burleigh
item.description: Born and raised in Annapolis, Lauren Burleigh brings hands-on experience across personal and commercial insurance, shaped by a family legacy in the industry that spans generations.

item.title: $6.5M for Recreation and Land Conservation in Ten Maryland Counties
item.description: The Board of Public Works approved $6.5 million in grants from the Maryland Department of Natural Resources to local governments and land trusts for recreation and land conservation.

item.title: National Park Service Awards $100,000 to the State of Maryland for AgriTrails
item.description: Maryland’s Best AgriTrails highlights Maryland food along with outdoor recreation

item.title: Free Trees Available for Maryland’s ‘Backyard Buffers’
item.description: The Maryland Department of Natural Resources is offering free tree seedlings to landowners statewide who have a creek, drainage ditch, stream, or other waterway on or near their property.

item.title: Midwinter Waterfowl Survey Shows Second Consecutive Population Increase
item.description: Above average Canada goose and diving duck numbers likely reflect colder winter

item.title: What's Up? This Weekend 2/4
item.description: From live music and comedy to community gatherings, family fun, arts, sports, and hands-on experiences, the coming week is packed with ways to get out and enjoy winter in the Chesapeake region.
